verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent pieces: documents attached to cap table transactions, custom report views, and segmented permissions for internal team members. Nothing documents a shareable, permissioned data room for external counsel or investors that combines cap table views with underlying documents, so these adjacent features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
